name: change-reply-scenario-timeout
goal: The agent-references change-reply scenario command finishes its four unchanged tests within their unchanged deadlines, or the cause is documented.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
